text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: My vision of victory—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Going beyond El and the others to win
the Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe. And
Teach is gonna be alive to
see it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If both conditions aren't met, I lose. It
makes my
chances of winning close to
zero.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So I need a favor.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Will you come with me real quick?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hello—oh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Taking a nap, Teach?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Well, at least you look
comfortable. Hope
you don't mind if I go
ahead and start talking.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You and I have a long history together,
don't we,
Teach?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You were always so strict back then.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You never had a chance at catching us
running
full speed, but that never
stopped you from
trying.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Then you'd give us an earful the next
day at
school.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If you like a good adrenaline rush, you
ought to
do more nail-biting challenges.
Put those legs of
yours to some use!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's because of you I entered Tracen... so I could take on those nail-biting challenges you spoke of.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I stepped upon the stage where the
greatest races
unfold.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Even teamed up with a trainer who says
crazy
stuff like "let's pick a fight with the
whole world."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I've come to think that making a gamble
is a
choice. It's a choice that can decide
outcomes for
your whole life.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: When that moment comes, I wonder how clammy my hands will get. I'll probably be flustered, overwhelmed, and confused.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...It'll be the worst feeling in the world,
and at the
same time... the best.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...So keep on living, Teach. Watch me.
Watch how
I live.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Your hopes will not be crushed.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry, but I think I'll cry if I open
my eyes.
choice_data_list: もう彼女、行っちゃいましたよ

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
She's really become an inspiration,
hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Here we are at the Japan Cup, ready to
face off.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing really to say, is there,
El? We can
let our legs do the talking.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Nakayama. Show me how
much
you've grown!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you've got it in you.
